notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balance (p4, Total column); governmental fund balance roll-forward: 417,123 + 256,105 - 309,290 + transfers in 73 - transfers out 2,835 + bond proceeds 59,975 + other financing 1,577 (Grants 500 + Insurance proceeds 1,077) = 422,728. Beginning cash is not printed (no prior-year balance sheet), so beginning_cash is null; ending_cash = Cash and Equivalents + Restricted Cash (p3); Due from County Treasurer 2,719 is a separate asset. Business-type (Water, Sewer) lines come from the Total column of the proprietary Combined Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Net Position (p11), measure cash, as in FY2024; interest income and debt service are printed below the operating totals (outside_printed_total); the Total column's Misc. Expense sign error is recorded in report_discrepancies. Bonding costs 400 and County commissions 224 (Debt Service Fund) are counted in General government on the Statement of Activities. proprietary left null (cash basis, as FY2024). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p3, totals equal the government-wide governmental column), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: General Fund revenue and other financing from the budget schedule (p5); General Fund spending from the department schedules (pp6-8), not the p5 department totals (no double counting); Debt Service Fund (p9); Water and Sewer fund budget schedules (pp12-13) incl. nonoperating lines printed below the operating totals (outside_printed_total). Read pages 1-14 of 14 Aligned with FY2024 (2026-11-12): beginning_cash 417,123 (Statement of Activities p2) and ending_cash 422,728 (governmental funds Total Assets p3); transfers_out is the Total column's printed net transfers (2,762).
